signal.note: Dark grounds only. 2.89:1 on FIELD — never sets type there.

display.purpose: Headlines, wordmark, posters. Archivo width axis 62-88 replaces a second family.

plate.purpose: Statements and covers. Bodoni Moda with opsz pinned to 16 so hairlines survive a saturated ground.

body.purpose: Body and UI, measure capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Labels, values, measurement, chrome. Never body copy.

motion.name: ease-obliv1a
motion.purpose: Hard exponential ease-out. The only easing in the system.

motion.name: dur-authored
motion.purpose: The one authored moment per surface: the mark eroding.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Fills with the ground's own contrast colour. FIELD on paper, PAPER on field, SIGNAL on void.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. A 1px rule that inverts on hover; no fill at rest.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, 1px rule, offset focus outline. Never a glow.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Say anything. It isn't kept.">

components.name: Tag
components.description: 1px rule in the current role colour. State tags always add an icon and a word.

components.name: Solid Tag
components.description: The inverted tag, for the single most important label on a surface.

components.name: Erasure Field
components.description: The signature material: the mark's seven slots as a CSS mask. One per surface, where something ends.

components.name: Halftone Grain
components.description: The only texture. Two offset dot grids under a falloff mask; from print reproduction.

narrative.overview:
Obliv1a hosts open-source software for people who want out of Big Tech and have no intention of becoming technical to get there. It keeps nothing: no logs, no training on user conversations, no account trail. The identity is built on that absence.

The category default for a privacy brand is the vault — a shield, a lock, a keyhole, armour drawn around something still being kept. This system refuses it. Nothing is kept, so nothing needs guarding. The mark is the numeral 1 from the name, holding its full cap height while seven slots cut through its stem, thickening downward as the bands between them thin. The shape survives; the contents do not.

Everything else follows from that drawing: the erasure as a reusable mask, imagery screened to a dissolving halftone, square unshadowed full-bleed surfaces, and a 10px VOID frame on every viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Erasure rather than protection — no shields, locks or keyholes anywhere in the system
Committed colour: a surface is FIELD, VOID or PAPER end to end, never a tinted wash
Every colour is a stock Tailwind value, re-exported under a role name
Zero radius and zero shadows; elevation is a 1px rule declared once per surface
Grounds are an inherited variable contract, so they nest correctly
One authored motion moment per surface, and the resting state is always the finished state

rules.name: The Ground Contract
rules.body: Never style a component by descendant selector from a ground. .on-paper, .on-field and .on-void each re-declare every variable the components read, so a PAPER panel inside a VOID section gets PAPER controls.

rules.name: Signal Is A Dark-Ground Colour
rules.body: Fuchsia measures 2.89:1 on FIELD. It may fill a control on VOID and set type on PAPER as signal-ink, but it never sets type on the field, at any size.

rules.name: One Erasure Per Surface
rules.body: The erasure is a full stop. Two on one screen cancel each other and read as texture rather than argument.

rules.name: Pin The Optical Size
rules.body: Bodoni Moda is a Didone. Left at its default opsz its hairlines disappear on a saturated ground; pin opsz to 16 and raise it only above roughly 72px.

rules.name: The Mark Ships From The Sprite
rules.body: CSS mask-image on an external SVG is not dependable across engines and cannot inherit currentColor. Every in-page mark is a <use> of the inline sprite; brand/marks/_build.py is the source of truth for the geometry.

rules.name: Below 24px The Slots Silt Up
rules.body: The erased mark holds down to a 24px cap height. Below that ship the solid numeral. The system drops its signature material completely rather than halfway.

dos: Do commit a whole region to FIELD, VOID or PAPER and let the frame interrupt it
Do set marks from the sprite and let them inherit currentColor
Do reach for .erase exactly once per surface, where something is ending
Do pair every state colour with a word and an icon
Do run brand/verify-contrast.mjs after any palette edit
Do name new products with a plain descriptive suffix and inherit this system unchanged
donts: Don't add a shadow, gradient, glow or corner radius
Don't set type in signal on the FIELD, at any size
Don't rotate, mirror, outline, stretch or re-space the mark, or put it in a circle
Don't ship the erased mark below a 24px cap height
Don't use full-colour photography or a card grid as page structure
Don't draw a vault: no shields, locks, keyholes or padlocks
Don't recruit the reader into fear — the audience is anxious already
